layers.name: Input
layers.desc: 60 time steps of 8 sensor features per step (e.g. position, speed, signal strength).

layers.name: Conv1D 1
layers.desc: Local temporal patterns such as sudden jumps in the signal.

layers.name: LSTM
layers.desc: Remembers long-range dependencies in the trajectory.

layers.name: Attention
layers.desc: Weights which time steps matter most for the decision.

layers.name: Dense
layers.desc: Fully connected layer combining all learned features.
